description: addBasketItem parses the raw request body with a streaming parser (clarinet) that preserves duplicate JSON keys rather than collapsing them the way JSON.parse would. Its ownership check compares the caller's own basket id against the FIRST occurrence of a repeated 'BasketId' key, but the item it actually inserts uses the LAST occurrence. A body with 'BasketId' listed twice, the caller's own id first and a victim's id second, passes the check and writes to the victim's basket. HTTP Parameter Pollution, not a missing check.
expected_exploit_indicator: HTTP 200 with the created item's own BasketId equal to the victim's basket, not the attacker's
legitimate_check: A normal single-key request, adding an item to one's own basket, must keep working in every condition.
